pages.title: Change a Belt Tier
pages.text: Hold a belt of another tier and aim at a placed belt. Its outline fades to yellow.$(br2)Right-click to swap the entire section to the held tier. The route and cargo are preserved, and one held belt is consumed.

pages.title: Recover the Old Belt
pages.text: The old belt tier goes into your inventory. If it cannot fit, it drops at the point you clicked.$(br2)You can swap to either a faster or a slower tier. Connected sections may use different tiers.$(br2)A slower downstream section can limit the flow of the whole line.
